purpose: Six hand-painted sequential right-facing walking poses for classic adventure game; fictional visual reconstruction, not an authenticated historical portrait.
bbox_convention: cell-relative [left, top, right exclusive, bottom exclusive]; alpha_gt_0 preserves low alpha generator noise; alpha_gt_8 defines visible silhouette.
common_crop_method: Union of all six cell-relative alpha>8 bounding boxes, expanded 8 pixels and clipped to 512x512; same crop applied to every frame. Original PNG bytes unchanged.
rendering_note: Use identical crop dimensions, scale and anchor on every pose. Never fit each alpha bounding box separately. Slight drawn body bob and foot differences are natural generated variations.

visual_qa.assessment: Six clearly differing leg and arm poses; stable clothing identity, right-facing whole-body figures; opposite-arm stride alternation is visually evident across cycle halves. Generated rather than rigged animation, so small proportions/height differences remain.

prompt: Create a production 2D adventure-game WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET, 1536 pixels wide x 1024 pixels high, transparent RGBA background. EXACT layout: 3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512 pixel cells; six complete FULL BODY figures of THE SAME man, one figure centered within every cell. Use first attached portrait as exact character and clothing reference, second attached camp only as painted art style reference. Character is François Raynal: thin weathered man with tousled sandy brown hair, short sandy beard, long olive brown ragged patched wool coat, green waistcoat, off-white open collar shirt, patched charcoal trousers rolled at cuffs, worn brown lace boots. NO hat. Painterly classic hand-painted realistic adventure-game art, opaque crisp character silhouettes with detailed brushwork matching the supplied camp. All six figures face RIGHT in the same mostly side profile with slight three-quarter visibility. Same head size and full body scale throughout. Top of hair approximately cell y=35, boot ground baseline y=480. Center torso cell x=256. Arms visibly swing freely and legs visibly WALK, no standing portrait pose. Six DIFFERENT sequential frames, reading left to right top row then bottom row: 1 left boot forward/right boot back, wide contact stride, right arm forward; 2 weight down on forward left boot, trailing right heel lifting, knees bent; 3 left support leg under body, right bent leg passing it and raised boot, arms passing torso; 4 right boot forward/left boot back, opposite wide contact stride, left arm forward; 5 weight down on forward right boot, trailing left heel lifting, knees bent; 6 right support leg under body, left bent leg passing it with raised boot, arms passing torso. Alternating front leg MUST be apparent. Anatomy natural and fluid, walking with determined tired life. Keep every head at same height and each figure inside its own cell with at least 20px margin. No background, no atmosphere behind figure, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no numbers, no frames or grid lines, no extra objects. Output exactly six poses, consistent character.
